climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state whose wine industry was founded by German immigrants in the 19th century, which gave its wine corridor the name Missouri Rhineland. It was the nation's second-largest producer before Prohibition. Norton, Vignoles and Chambourcin are the most planted grapes.
